'''2006 Rhode Island State Championship Casey Anis LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2006 Rhode Island State Championship]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Casey "spideyguy0" Anis (2006-07-03).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35620 Tat Mains post-errata pre-redux]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070527162331/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35620&PHPSESSID=563c9cb66893f1410eb8068266c38feb Internet Archive]</ref>
